result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout and content truncation issues.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel are truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...') and the third card is cut off at the right edge without a clear visual indicator that more content can be scrolled.
issues.suggestion: Add ellipsis handling consistently and consider a partial-card peek or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons are inconsistent between cards — the Tokumaru Ramen card shows a white heart on a light chip, while the pizza card shows a heart on a dark circular background. This inconsistency looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon container style and contrast across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appears cut off at the right edge, suggesting more categories but without a visible scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade or partial chip at the edge to indicate the list is horizontally scrollable.
